name: Theo
source: A guy who has been living in Neyris's house while she wasn’t around. He is cold and surly when he first speaks with her. He has a good reason - she made Theo her slave in exchange for letting him stay in the house without paying money. He has no interest in magic, and doesn’t care whether a person is a dark or light magician, a dragon, or a monster. Theo likes human-made inventions – something that is really weird for a magician. In his spare time, he constructs mechanisms in his room.
